issues.legal_issue: A general release of claims to a father's self-acquired property does not extend to an interest in property that later becomes joint-family property when that interest was not contemplated by the parties.
material_facts: When the son executed the release, the family had no joint-family property, and the property covered by the release was described as the father's self-acquired property.
The release relinquished the son's claims to that property during his father's lifetime and after his death.
The father's self-acquired property became joint-family property later, an eventuality not contemplated when the release was executed.
issues.conclusion: The release did not relinquish the son's interest in the property after it became joint-family property.
issues.legal_principle: Under the rule stated in Chinnathasi v. Kulasekara (1952) SCR 241, general words of release are limited to rights then in issue or contemplated by the parties and do not release rights outside those circumstances. The release was therefore confined to the claims to the father's property that the parties had in mind when it was executed.

rule.if: partition_decree_appeal and release_of_claims_to_father_property and no_joint_family_property_at_release and later_conversion_to_joint_family_property

predicates.partition_decree_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal from a decree in a suit seeking partition of family property.
predicates.release_of_claims_to_father_property: A family member executed a release relinquishing claims to a father's property that was then treated as the father's own property.
predicates.no_joint_family_property_at_release: The family had no joint-family property when the release was executed.
predicates.later_conversion_to_joint_family_propert: The father's property later became joint-family property.

issues.definition: When a partition-decree appeal concerns a release of claims to a father's own property, and there was no joint-family property at the time but the property later became joint-family property, the release does not cover the later joint-family interest.

issues.legal_issue: A family member's release of claims to a father's self-acquired property and temporary separate residence do not establish severance from the joint family where the release was made before joint-family property existed and the family member continued to be regarded as part of the family.
material_facts: The family had no joint-family property when the son executed the release, which concerned claims to his father's self-acquired property.
The son lived separately for a time because of discord with his father, but the release did not establish that he had left the family.
A later document cancelling the father's will contemplated division of the property among all his sons.
The son returned to live with the family and remained there until his death.
The father's self-acquired property was later treated as joint-family property.
issues.conclusion: The son remained a member of the joint family when the property became joint-family property, and his share passed to his widow on his death.
issues.legal_principle: Under Mitakshara law, renunciation by a coparcener of his interest in joint-family property separates him from the other members. But a release concerning a father's self-acquired property, executed when the family has no joint-family property, does not itself cause severance of joint status; temporary separate residence alone does not establish that the family member left the joint family. The later evidence showed that the son remained a member of the family.

rule.if: partition_decree_appeal and release_when_no_joint_family_property and release_concerns_fathers_own_property and temporary_separate_residence_only and later_family_membership_evidence

predicates.partition_decree_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal from a decree in a suit seeking partition of family property.
predicates.release_when_no_joint_family_property: A family member executed a release when the family had no joint-family property.
predicates.release_concerns_fathers_own_property: The release concerned claims to the father's own property rather than an existing interest in joint-family property.
predicates.temporary_separate_residence_only: The family member lived apart temporarily because of discord but did not thereby leave the joint family.
predicates.later_family_membership_evidence: Later conduct or family documents showed that the family member continued to be treated as part of the family.

issues.definition: When a partition-decree appeal concerns a release made before joint-family property existed, the release concerns the father's own property, separate residence was only temporary, and later evidence shows continued family membership, the family member remains in the joint family and his share passes to his widow.
